summary: Store plan data under refs/ldd/plans/<id> and move every stored plan there
riskReason: Every stored plan moves, and the old refs have to be removed on GitHub too. A half-done move leaves plans in two places.

change.to: one refspec, refs/ldd/*, for fetch and push, plus refs/heads/* for push

rules.text: each stored plan is moved with its full event history: the new ref points at the old tip, created with a compare-and-swap against the zero ID, and the old ref is deleted with a compare-and-swap against that tip
the move covers every plan in this repo (#1 to #5); the scenario repos are gone (#5)
the human pushes the moved refs and deletes the old refs on GitHub; the agent never pushes
refs/ldd/config keeps syncing: refs/ldd/* covers it
setup removes the old refs/plans/* and refs/ldd/config refspecs from a clone it has already set up, so they don't linger

invariants.text: every plan's tip commit and event history are unchanged by the move
no refs/plans/* ref is left in this repo

add.type: 'refs/ldd/', the one spelling of the tool's namespace

add.signature: (spec) => whether a refspec belongs to the tool

evidence: git for-each-ref refs/plans/ is empty, and refs/ldd/plans/ lists the same IDs with the same tips as before
git ls-remote shows refs/ldd/plans/* and no refs/plans/* on GitHub, after the human pushes
